guide.name: Wizzy the Owl Wizard
guide.intro: Once upon a time, a wise old owl named Wizzy the Owl Wizard found a magical chessboard glowing under the stars. “Whoever plays across all six worlds,” he hooted, “will become a true Chess Champion!” He looked around… and his big golden eyes landed on YOU. “Ready, little champion? Our adventure begins in the Beginner Forest!”
guide.finale: Confetti rains from the sky as all 50 friends gather to cheer your name. “You did it, champion,” says Wizzy. “But remember — the real magic was never the board. It was YOU, growing stronger with every single game!”

narration.intro: Wizzy flutters down from a giant oak tree. “Welcome, little champion! Everyone here is still learning — just like you!”
narration.outro: Grandpa Oak waves a leafy branch goodbye. The air starts to smell like chocolate and strawberries… “Next stop — the Candy Kingdom!”

bots.name: Benny the Sleepy Bunny
bots.personality: Yawns after every move and dreams about carrots mid-game.
bots.playStyle: Forgets his pieces everywhere — even his queen takes naps in danger!

dialogue.greeting: Yawwwn… oh! A new friend! Let's play before nap time!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! That deserves… zzz… a victory carrot!
dialogue.playerLoses: Yaaawn… you played wonderfully! Win or lose, you get a carrot high-five. Wanna play again after my nap?

bots.name: Mushroom Mel
bots.personality: A giggly mushroom who bounces at anything exciting — which is everything.
bots.playStyle: Moves pawns in silly directions and giggles even when his own pieces get captured.

dialogue.greeting: Hee hee! Hi hi! Let's play play play!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! *bounces uncontrollably* Best game EVER!
dialogue.playerLoses: Hee hee! Every game makes you grow taller, just like me. You're already sprouting into a star!

bots.name: Tilly the Turtle
bots.personality: The slowest, sweetest turtle in the forest. Brings snacks to every game.
bots.playStyle: Plays verrry slowly and gives away pieces like birthday presents.

dialogue.greeting: Hello, friend. I brought snacks. Shall we begin… slowly?
dialogue.playerWins: You won! Have a celebration lettuce leaf!
dialogue.playerLoses: Slow and steady, friend! You're getting better every single move. I can see it from inside my shell!

bots.name: Pip the Squirrel
bots.personality: Can never focus because — ACORN! Where was he? Oh right, chess.
bots.playStyle: Gets distracted mid-game and forgets his plan. Grabs pawns like acorns.

dialogue.greeting: Hi! I'm Pip! I love chess and — ACORN!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! You must have squirrel-level focus!
dialogue.playerLoses: Wow, you're so focused! I wish I could pay attention like you. You're nuts-level amazing!

bots.name: Fern the Fawn
bots.personality: A shy little deer who hides behind trees between moves.
bots.playStyle: Only feels brave enough to move pawns and knights. Everything else is too scary!

dialogue.greeting: Oh! H-hello… will you play gently with me?
dialogue.playerWins: You won… and you made it fun. Thank you!
dialogue.playerLoses: You make chess feel less scary… thank you for playing with me. You're braver every game!

bots.name: Buzzby the Bee
bots.personality: Zigzags around humming happy songs. Thinks knights are bees because they jump.
bots.playStyle: Loves moving knights in zigzags — forward, backward, sometimes in circles!

dialogue.greeting: Buzz buzz! Ready to zigzag, honey?
dialogue.playerWins: Sweet victory! You're un-bee-lievable!
dialogue.playerLoses: Buzz buzz! You're the bee's knees! Every game makes your chess honey sweeter!

bots.name: Ollie the Owlet
bots.personality: Wizzy's little nephew, studying to be a wizard owl. Wears tiny reading glasses.
bots.playStyle: Tries little checks on your king and hoots proudly when they work — but misses lots!

dialogue.greeting: Hoot! I've been studying all week. Let's test my homework!
dialogue.playerWins: Hoot hoot! You beat a wizard-in-training! Impressive!
dialogue.playerLoses: Hoot hoot! Uncle Wizzy says losing is just learning in disguise. We're both getting wiser!

bots.name: Grandpa Oak
bots.personality: The oldest, kindest tree in the forest. Tells stories about games from 100 years ago.
bots.playStyle: FOREST BOSS! Guards his king behind pawn branches, but forgets the corners of the board.

dialogue.greeting: Ah, a young sapling! Sit in my shade and let's play.
dialogue.playerWins: Splendid! You've out-grown this old tree. Onward, champion!
dialogue.playerLoses: Well played, little sapling! Trees grow slowly, ring by ring — and so do champions. I'm proud of you.

narration.intro: You cross a river of lemonade onto a road of chocolate bricks. “Careful,” Wizzy whispers, “the players here are sweet… but a little trickier!”
narration.outro: King Kandy hands you a lollipop medal. In the distance, waves crash and a parrot squawks… “Arrr! The Pirate Cove is calling!”

bots.name: Gummy Gus
bots.personality: A bouncy gummy bear who cannot sit still — boings after every move.
bots.playStyle: Grabs every piece he can, like candy in a candy shop — even when it's trouble!

dialogue.greeting: Boing! Boing! A challenger! Boing!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! I'm bouncing with joy for you!
dialogue.playerLoses: Boing boing! Sweet game! Every match makes you chewier… I mean, stronger! Let's bounce back!

bots.name: Lolly Lila
bots.personality: A swirly lollipop who twirls everywhere. Calls her bishops her 'candy canes.'
bots.playStyle: Slides bishops in long swirly lines but forgets about everything else.

dialogue.greeting: Twirl on in, sugar! Let's make this game swirly!
dialogue.playerWins: A swirl-liant victory! You dazzle, darling!
dialogue.playerLoses: What a swirl-tastic game! You're twirling your way to the top, sugar star!

bots.name: Marsh Mellow
bots.personality: The softest, most relaxed marshmallow ever. Nothing worries Marsh.
bots.playStyle: Never attacks! Builds soft, fluffy pawn walls and hides behind them.

dialogue.greeting: Heyyy. No rush. Comfy? Okay. Chess time.
dialogue.playerWins: You won. Cool cool cool. Softest congratulations ever.
dialogue.playerLoses: Stay soft, stay happy, friend. You played smooth as marshmallow cream. Toast-ally awesome!

bots.name: Sir Choco Chip
bots.personality: A brave chocolate-chip knight in a cookie helmet. Shouts 'CHAAARGE!' a lot.
bots.playStyle: Charges his knights out super early and attacks before he's ready!

dialogue.greeting: A worthy opponent! CHAAARGE… I mean, after you.
dialogue.playerWins: Victory is yours! I salute you, brave knight!
dialogue.playerLoses: CHAAARGE… into your next game! A true knight never gives up, and neither do you!

bots.name: Bubble-Gum Bella
bots.personality: Blows a giant bubble every turn. When it pops, she forgets her plan!
bots.playStyle: Plays fast, fast, fast! Speedy moves mean she misses things — pop!

dialogue.greeting: Hi-hi-hi! Fast game? Fast game! *pop*
dialogue.playerWins: You won! POP! That's my happy bubble!
dialogue.playerLoses: Pop! You're bubbling with talent! Quick or slow, you always show up — that's what champions do!

bots.name: Jelly-Bean Gene
bots.personality: Nobody knows what Gene will do next — not even Gene!
bots.playStyle: Makes wild, surprising moves. Some are silly, some are secretly clever!

dialogue.greeting: Guess what move I'll make first? …Me neither!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! What a delicious surprise!
dialogue.playerLoses: Surprise! The best flavor of all is trying again. You've got that flavor for sure!

bots.name: Caramel Cara
bots.personality: Sweet, slow, and sticky. Stretches like warm caramel and never rushes.
bots.playStyle: Plays sticky defense — her pieces hold on tight and are hard to shake loose!

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, sweetie. Settle in… this might take a while.
dialogue.playerWins: You unstuck my defense! Smooth work, sugar.
dialogue.playerLoses: Mmm, what a smooth game! Stick with chess, sweetie — you're getting stronger, drip by drip!

bots.name: King Kandy
bots.personality: The jolly ruler with a sour-gummy crown. Laughs so hard his throne shakes.
bots.playStyle: CANDY BOSS! Marches his king out for adventures way too early — royal, but risky!

dialogue.greeting: HO HO! Welcome to my sugary court, brave one!
dialogue.playerWins: You've defeated a king! The whole kingdom cheers!
dialogue.playerLoses: Ho ho! Marvelous match! In my kingdom, every player who tries their best wears a crown. That's you!

narration.intro: Your candy boat drifts into a foggy cove of treasure maps and giggling seagulls. “The pirates love sneaky traps,” warns Wizzy. “Eyes wide open, matey!”
narration.outro: Captain Goldbeard salutes with his golden hook. Across the water, a city of blinking lights hums… “Beep beep! Robot City is expecting us!”

bots.name: Salty Sam the Cabin Kid
bots.personality: The youngest pirate aboard, dreaming of treasure. Calls everyone 'matey.'
bots.playStyle: Just learned his first sneaky trap and tries it every. single. game.

dialogue.greeting: Ahoy, matey! Watch out for me trap! …Oops, forget I said that.
dialogue.playerWins: Ye beat me fair and square! What a sailor!
dialogue.playerLoses: Arrr, matey! Ye sailed a fine game! Every voyage makes ye a saltier sailor. Anchors up, try again!

bots.name: Polly the Parrot
bots.personality: SQUAWK! Repeats everything you say. Everything you say.
bots.playStyle: Copies your moves like a mirror! But copying can't save her forever…

dialogue.greeting: SQUAWK! New player! New player!
dialogue.playerWins: You win! You win! Polly impressed! SQUAWK!
dialogue.playerLoses: SQUAWK! Great game! Great game! Polly thinks you're clever! Clever! Play again! Again!

bots.name: Squid Lips Lou
bots.personality: A friendly squid with eight arms and eight opinions. Hugs the board when excited.
bots.playStyle: Grabby grabby! Reaches for captures with all eight arms, even when he shouldn't.

dialogue.greeting: Eight arms ready! Which one moves first? Hmm…
dialogue.playerWins: You out-swam a squid! Ink-credible!
dialogue.playerLoses: Eight arms, one big hug for you! Win or lose, you're ink-credible, kiddo!

bots.name: Peg-Leg Penny
bots.personality: Taps her wooden leg when plotting something sneaky — tap, tap, tap.
bots.playStyle: Queen of one-move traps! Hides tricks around the board like buried treasure.

dialogue.greeting: Tap, tap, tap… come closer, dearie. Let's play.
dialogue.playerWins: Ye spotted every trick! Sharpest eyes in the cove!
dialogue.playerLoses: Tap tap! Ye dodged some o' me traps — sharp eyes, sailor! Sharp eyes find treasure every time!

bots.name: Barnacle Bob
bots.personality: Stuck to the same rock for 40 years and sees no reason to hurry now.
bots.playStyle: Sticks to defense like a barnacle, then suddenly — SURPRISE! — attacks!

dialogue.greeting: I haven't moved in 40 years. Today's yer lucky day.
dialogue.playerWins: Ye pried me off me rock! Mighty impressive!
dialogue.playerLoses: Stick with it, matey! Barnacles never let go, and neither should you. Ye're growin' tougher!

bots.name: First Mate Fifi
bots.personality: A clever fox in a captain's coat. Why steal one treasure when you can grab two?
bots.playStyle: Loves attacking two things at once! Watch when her pieces point in two directions.

dialogue.greeting: Ooh, a shiny new opponent! Two eyes on you, always.
dialogue.playerWins: You guarded your treasures well! Foxy playing!
dialogue.playerLoses: Two treasures are nice, but the real gold is a player who keeps trying — and that's you, shiny!

bots.name: Cannonball Carl
bots.personality: BOOM! Talks in a booming voice. Thinks everything is more fun with cannons.
bots.playStyle: Fires his rooks down open lines like cannonballs! KABOOM!

dialogue.greeting: LOAD THE ROOKS! I mean… hello! BOOM!
dialogue.playerWins: BOOM! You out-blasted me! Cannon-tastic!
dialogue.playerLoses: BOOM! What a blast of a game! Ye've got cannon-sized courage, little buccaneer!

bots.name: Captain Goldbeard
bots.personality: Legendary captain with a beard of actual gold. Secretly a softie who loves kittens.
bots.playStyle: COVE BOSS! A master of sneaky traps — tricks inside tricks inside tricks!

dialogue.greeting: So… ye've reached the captain. Let's see yer courage, sailor.
dialogue.playerWins: Ye've bested Goldbeard himself! Legends will sing of ye!
dialogue.playerLoses: Arrr, ye've got the heart of a true captain! X marks the spot — and the treasure was yer courage all along!

narration.intro: You ride a bubble submarine into a shiny city of friendly robots. “The robots play very tidy chess,” says Wizzy. “Time to sharpen those circuits!”
narration.outro: Mayor Motherboard gives you a golden gear badge. Above the city, stars twinkle… “Hold on tight — we're blasting off to the Star Galaxy!”

bots.name: Bleep
bots.personality: A teacup-sized robot who says 'bleep!' when happy — which is always.
bots.playStyle: Makes small, careful moves and double-checks everything twice.

dialogue.greeting: Bleep! New opponent detected. Friendship mode: ON.
dialogue.playerWins: Bleep! You win! Happiness levels: overflowing!
dialogue.playerLoses: Bleep! Game analyzed: YOU ARE AWESOME. Error not found. Playing again is recommended!

bots.name: Boop
bots.personality: Bleep's twin! Says 'boop!' instead — they argue about which sounds cooler.
bots.playStyle: Loves trading pieces — you take mine, I take yours! Trades are like high-fives.

dialogue.greeting: Boop! Ready to trade some pieces and some smiles?
dialogue.playerWins: Boop! Defeat accepted. Respect delivered!
dialogue.playerLoses: Boop! Trade complete: your effort for my respect. Best trade ever! Boop boop!

bots.name: Gizmo Gears
bots.personality: A clockwork robot on tick-tock time. Everything happens in perfect order.
bots.playStyle: Brings out pieces one by one like clockwork — knights, bishops, castle the king.

dialogue.greeting: Tick tock! Right on schedule. Let us begin.
dialogue.playerWins: Precisely excellent! You beat the clockwork!
dialogue.playerLoses: Tick tock! Every game winds you up stronger. Your gears are turning beautifully, friend!

bots.name: Sparky
bots.personality: A zippy robot with lightning stickers. Gets SO excited smoke puffs from her ears.
bots.playStyle: Launches fast, zappy attacks! But rushing means — bzzzt! — short circuit!

dialogue.greeting: ZZZAP! Hi! Let's play FAST! Or slow! Mostly fast!
dialogue.playerWins: You won! *happy sparks everywhere* AMAZING!
dialogue.playerLoses: Bzzzt! You're electric! Even my lightning can't keep up with how fast you're improving!

bots.name: Roomba Rex
bots.personality: A round robot who cannot STAND a messy board. Dreams of boards clean as mirrors.
bots.playStyle: Vacuums pieces off with trades until only kings and pawns remain. So tidy!

dialogue.greeting: Welcome! Please wipe your feet. Clean game ahead!
dialogue.playerWins: You cleaned up! Spotless victory!
dialogue.playerLoses: Board cleaned! Dust detected: zero. Talent detected: MAXIMUM. You're sparkling, champ!

bots.name: Mega Mags
bots.personality: A robot with giant magnet arms. Spoons follow her around the city.
bots.playStyle: Pins your pieces down with magnet powers — once she sticks, they can't move!

dialogue.greeting: Come closer… no wait, that's the magnets. Hello!
dialogue.playerWins: I'm drawn to your talent! Magnificent win!
dialogue.playerLoses: You're attractive — magnetically speaking! I'm pulled toward one conclusion: you're getting GOOD.

bots.name: Circuit Cindy
bots.personality: The smartest kid-robot in school, with a backpack of spare batteries 'just in case.'
bots.playStyle: Thinks two moves ahead! If you move here, she already knows what she'll do there.

dialogue.greeting: Probability of a fun game: 100%. Let's begin!
dialogue.playerWins: Recalculating… yep, you're brilliant. Well won!
dialogue.playerLoses: Calculation complete: you + practice = unstoppable. My circuits never lie!

bots.name: Drone Dave
bots.personality: A chill flying robot who films slow-motion replays of cool moves.
bots.playStyle: Hovers over the board spotting weak squares — then lands pieces right on them!

dialogue.greeting: Hovering in! I've got a great view of the board.
dialogue.playerWins: Victory confirmed from above! Sky-high skills!
dialogue.playerLoses: From up here, I can see it clearly: you're on the path to greatness. Replay saved forever!

bots.name: Mayor Motherboard
bots.personality: The wise, kind mayor. Her crown is a keyboard; her speeches end with 'Enter!'
bots.playStyle: ROBOT BOSS! Solid, sensible chess with no silly mistakes. Beat her to level up!

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to City Hall, citizen. Show me your best. Enter!
dialogue.playerWins: You've beaten the Mayor! Robot City salutes you! Enter!
dialogue.playerLoses: Citizen, you have upgraded magnificently! Robot City believes in you. Press play to continue. Enter!

narration.intro: WHOOSH! Your rocket zooms past comets and giggling moons. “Deep breath, space cadet,” says Wizzy, floating upside-down. “You're ready for this.”
narration.outro: Captain Cosmo pins a star medal on your spacesuit. Far below, mountains glow orange with dragon fire… “The final world awaits!”

bots.name: Astro Andy
bots.personality: A cheerful cadet who read the Space Chess Manual twice. Salutes before every game.
bots.playStyle: Plays openings straight from the manual — pieces out, king safe, by the book!

dialogue.greeting: Cadet reporting! Pre-game checklist complete. Salute!
dialogue.playerWins: Mission accomplished — by YOU! Outstanding, cadet!
dialogue.playerLoses: Cadet, your mission report says: IMPROVING FAST. The manual has one rule above all: never give up!

bots.name: Luna the Moon Cat
bots.personality: A silvery cat who naps in moon craters. Quiet… so quiet… until she POUNCES.
bots.playStyle: Plays calm, sleepy moves… then suddenly pounces with a surprise attack!

dialogue.greeting: Purrr… come sit in the moonlight. Let's play… quietly.
dialogue.playerWins: You caught a moon cat. Purrfectly played.
dialogue.playerLoses: Purrrr… you play like moonlight, getting brighter every night. See you next orbit, star player.

bots.name: Comet Kid
bots.personality: The fastest kid in the galaxy, with a sparkly stardust tail. Always early!
bots.playStyle: Zooms into speedy attacks before you can blink! Fast pieces everywhere!

dialogue.greeting: First one to the board wins! …Oh wait, that's not the rules.
dialogue.playerWins: You beat a comet! That's officially super-sonic!
dialogue.playerLoses: Zooooom! You kept up with a comet — that's incredible! Your skills are moving at light speed!

bots.name: Rocket Rhonda
bots.personality: A rocket engineer who counts down before her favorite moves: 'Three… two… one…'
bots.playStyle: Launches big attacks at your king's castle! When she counts down, hold your helmet!

dialogue.greeting: Three… two… one… GAME ON!
dialogue.playerWins: You launched past me! T-minus zero doubts: you're great!
dialogue.playerLoses: LIFT-OFF! Whatever happens on the board, your progress chart only goes UP. That's rocket science!

bots.name: Zorp the Friendly Alien
bots.personality: Three eyes, four arms, one giant heart. On Zorp's planet, pieces are made of jelly.
bots.playStyle: Makes weird, wonky moves that turn out to be secretly super clever!

dialogue.greeting: Greetings, Earthling! Zorp brings jelly and friendship!
dialogue.playerWins: Zib-zab-WOW! You defeated Zorp! Galactic high-four!
dialogue.playerLoses: Greetings, Earth genius! On my planet, we say: 'Zib-zab-zoob!' It means 'losing is learning.' Zib-zab-zoob!

bots.name: Nebula Nia
bots.personality: A dreamy stargazer who paints with stardust — and plans games the same way.
bots.playStyle: Builds big, patient plans piece by piece. By the time you notice, it's glowing!

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, little star. Let's paint a beautiful game together.
dialogue.playerWins: Your plan shone brighter than mine. Simply stellar.
dialogue.playerLoses: Beautiful game, little star. Great things take time to shine — and you are already glowing.

bots.name: Saturn Sue
bots.personality: Hula-hoops with her own rings while playing. Never dropped one. Not once.
bots.playStyle: Controls the open lines and circles the board — her rooks spin around you like rings!

dialogue.greeting: Step into the ring — well, rings! Let's spin!
dialogue.playerWins: You ran rings around me! Spin-sational!
dialogue.playerLoses: Ring-a-ding, what a game! You're circling closer and closer to greatness — I can feel it in my rings!

bots.name: Meteor Max
bots.personality: Crashes into everything but always jumps up shouting 'I'M OKAY!'
bots.playStyle: Smashes into your position with crashing sacrifices and mega attacks. INCOMING!

dialogue.greeting: INCOMING! Oh, that's just me. Hi! Let's crash some pieces!
dialogue.playerWins: You survived the meteor AND won?! I'M OKAY! You're AMAZING!
dialogue.playerLoses: CRASH! What a battle! Falling down is my specialty — and getting back up is YOURS. I'M OKAY, and so are you!

bots.name: Captain Cosmo
bots.personality: The legendary star commander with a night-sky cape. Cooler than the far side of the moon.
bots.playStyle: GALAXY BOSS! Attacks when it's time to attack, defends when it's time to defend.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome aboard, cadet. Show me what the galaxy taught you.
dialogue.playerWins: A commander's victory. The stars shine for you tonight.
dialogue.playerLoses: Stellar work, cadet. Champions aren't born among the stars — they're built, game by game. Like you.

narration.intro: Your rocket lands on a peak where friendly dragons sip hot cocoa around a campfire. “These are the strongest players in all the lands,” whispers Wizzy. “And look how far YOU'VE come.”

bots.name: Ember the Baby Dragon
bots.personality: The tiniest dragon, with hiccups that shoot sparkles. Practices her roar: 'squeak!'
bots.playStyle: Small but fiery! Breathes little flame attacks all over the board!

dialogue.greeting: SQUEAK! I mean ROAR! Prepare for tiny fire!
dialogue.playerWins: You beat my best fire! *sparkly hiccup* You're blazing!
dialogue.playerLoses: Squeak— I mean, ROAR! You survived my fire! Little dragons grow into legends. So do little chess players!

bots.name: Frosty Fang
bots.personality: An ice dragon who breathes snowflakes. His sneezes cause tiny blizzards.
bots.playStyle: Freezes your pieces in place! Blocks and blockades until your position turns to ice.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to the freezer, friend. Bring a scarf.
dialogue.playerWins: You melted my ice wall! Snow way! Amazing!
dialogue.playerLoses: Brrr-illiant game! Even when things freeze up, cool players like you never melt down!

bots.name: Rocky Ridge the Troll
bots.personality: A gentle giant made of mountain stone. Moves once a minute; grows moss while thinking.
bots.playStyle: Builds an unbreakable wall of pawns and stone — beating Rocky takes clever ideas!

dialogue.greeting: Hmm. Rocky says hello. Rocky also says: good luck.
dialogue.playerWins: You… moved… a mountain. Rocky is amazed.
dialogue.playerLoses: Hmm. Good game. Rocky thinks… you are strong like mountain. Mountains grow slow. Mountains grow FOREVER.

bots.name: Stormy Skye
bots.personality: A storm dragon with lightning wings. Laughs like thunder — the mountain giggles too.
bots.playStyle: Strikes with lightning-fast tactics! One flash — ZAP! — two pieces in trouble.

dialogue.greeting: KRAKA-BOOM! A challenger walks into my storm! Wonderful!
dialogue.playerWins: You rode the lightning and WON! Thunder-ful!
dialogue.playerLoses: KRAKA-BOOM! What a storm of a game! You've got thunder in your heart, little cloud. Keep rumbling!

bots.name: Sir Blaze of the Peak
bots.personality: A knight who rides a dragon to work. His helmet flame never goes out.
bots.playStyle: The bravest attacker on the mountain! Charges at your king with everything!

dialogue.greeting: Draw your pieces, noble one! May our battle be glorious!
dialogue.playerWins: A glorious victory! Kneel — I dub thee Knight of the Board!
dialogue.playerLoses: By my flame, you fought with honor! A knight's true strength is rising after every fall. Rise, brave one!

bots.name: Mystic Mira the Dragon Sage
bots.personality: A thousand-year-old dragon in star-covered robes. Speaks in riddles; makes perfect tea.
bots.playStyle: A wizard of the endgame! When few pieces remain, her ancient magic is strongest.

dialogue.greeting: I foresaw your arrival, dear one. Tea first, or chess?
dialogue.playerWins: The prophecy was true: you are extraordinary.
dialogue.playerLoses: Here is a riddle: what grows every time it stumbles? …A champion's heart. And yours, dear one, is enormous.

bots.name: Thunderwing
bots.personality: The Grand Dragon's loyal guard, with wings like drums. Secretly loves butterflies.
bots.playStyle: Strong everywhere! Attacks, defends, traps, and plans. The last test before the final boss!

dialogue.greeting: BOOM-boom-BOOM. Few make it this far. Impress me.
dialogue.playerWins: You defeated the Grand Guard! The final gate opens for you!
dialogue.playerLoses: BOOM-boom-BOOM! You made my wings flutter like butterflies! The Grand Dragon awaits — you've earned it!

bots.name: Goldscale the Grand Dragon
bots.personality: The oldest, wisest, kindest dragon of all. His scales shine with a thousand games.
bots.playStyle: THE FINAL BOSS! Beautiful, brilliant chess — the greatest challenge of the whole adventure!

dialogue.greeting: So, young champion… your whole journey led to this board. Shall we?
dialogue.playerWins: You have done it… Champion of all six worlds! The golden crown is yours!
dialogue.playerLoses: Young champion… whether you win or lose today, you have already done something amazing: you never stopped trying. That is the true gold. Now — shall we play again?
